name: Perp-basis premium momentum — long spot when contango confirms leveraged demand
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the MOMENTUM read of the basis, opposite in sign to BOTH existing basis specs: perp-basis-discount-contrarian-long FADES a deep discount and perp-basis-premium-contrarian-short FADES a rich premium; this RIDES a moderate, building premium as confirmation, not as an extreme to fade): a positive perp-spot basis (perp trades above spot = contango) is the market paying up for leverage — a revealed, healthy bid for upside exposure. A MODERATE and rising premium (not the blow-off extreme the short leg fades) is the signature of a sustainable up-leg where leveraged demand confirms the spot move rather than over-crowding it. The basis is a spot-perp price spread, a higher-frequency, cleaner crowding read than realized funding, so it confirms a trend EARLIER. The trick is the band: enter on a premium ABOVE a confirmation floor but BELOW a froth ceiling (between two fitted params via two conditions), so we ride healthy contango and hand off to the contrarian short leg in the froth zone. Entry: perp_spot_basis above a fitted confirmation floor AND perp_spot_basis below a fitted froth ceiling AND price in an uptrend. Exit: perp_spot_basis crosses DOWN through the confirmation floor (leverage bid fading) or stop/TP/time. Disconfirmer 1: if an unconditional momentum long matches the deflated Sharpe, the basis band adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: basis and funding are tightly coupled; if a positive funding LEVEL gate does as well this is funding-carry-long re-skinned and adds no orthogonal SPREAD information. Disconfirmer 3: if the froth ceiling never binds (the optimizer pushes it to the data max), the spec is just 'positive basis + momentum' and the band thesis is unsupported. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier0 basis feature.
catalyst: a healthy (not frothy) perp premium confirming leveraged demand behind an up-leg
